series.definition: USGS Minerals Yearbook world production. Exact commodity, form, form detail, units and unit detail identify this series. Latest publication vintage per source year and country, as identified in every row; source editions are not averaged. Minerals Yearbook world production CSV. Exact material/form/unit dimensions remain separate. Each country/source-year uses its latest available publication vintage; all publisher vintages remain in the downloadable original CSV archive.
limitations: Retained source edition acquired 1 November 2026; publisher coverage and revisions vary by country and year.
Missing or ineligible source cells remain unavailable. No interpolation, carry-forward, zero filling, numerical unit conversion or averaging is performed.
Country, territory and aggregate accounts remain separate. Historical geographies are not reassigned to current successor states.
Compare the exact source definition, physical basis, unit and year. A production index, a percentage, a physical quantity and an accounting estimate answer different questions.

Latest publication vintage per source year is a declared selection across Minerals Yearbook source tables, not a single frozen survey vintage. Table definitions and rounding may change; original table notes accompany every selected row.
Multiple rows in the same latest publication vintage are unavailable for mapping; their source rows remain attached. Missing latest-vintage values are never replaced by older numerical observations.
World/region totals, historical geographies and unresolved country labels remain in the all-vintages source archive and geography register; no boundary reassignment or worldwide sum is constructed.
Even an unchanged country label may span boundary or reporting changes, such as Sudan. A constant modern polygon does not establish comparable historical territory.
Production is separate from reserves, capacity, consumption or physical shipment flows. Material content and gross mass are separate native dimensions.
